title: How a 19-year-old intern built the growth engine behind this $2B AI company | Hector Serrano
author: Lenny Rachitsky
description: Listen now (88 mins) | Hector Serrano on building Wispr Flow’s paid-UGC machine, hiring young talent over polished resumes, and why the best marketers are “allergic to AI”
summary: Hector Serrano runs one of the most innovative and successful paid growth programs in Silicon Valley. As Head of Content at Wispr Flow, a leading AI voice-to-text tool, he built a roster of 50 creators who drive 500 to 600 paid user-generated content (UGC) ads every month.
takeaways: Hector joined Wispr Flow at 19, before the product had PMF, and over the past year, Wispr Flow has grown revenue 30x and raised at a $2 billion valuation.
As Head of Content at Wispr Flow, a leading AI voice-to-text tool, he built a roster of 50 creators who drive 500 to 600 paid user-generated content (UGC) ads every month.
The creators are paid a cut of ad spend, and the best of them earn over $13,000 a month.
